subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): generic outbound delivery-report seam; WhatsApp native auto-reply reports provider-accepted sends

question: Should OpenClaw accept `openclaw/plugin-sdk/outbound-delivery-report` as the public contract for plugin-self-delivered outbound messages?
rationale: The code path is technically coherent, but the new SDK subpath, idempotency behavior, and fail-open semantics become a compatibility contract for third-party plugins once released.

options.title: Accept After Proof
options.body: Require redacted WhatsApp or runtime proof, then merge if maintainers accept the proposed subpath and report contract.

options.title: Pause API Design
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and ask for a narrower or differently named SDK contract before merging this branch.

recommendation.title: Accept After Proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted WhatsApp or runtime proof, then merge if maintainers accept the proposed subpath and report contract.

likelyOwner.reason: He posted landing verification for the prior outbound hook contract work and is the strongest available routing candidate for this compatibility decision.
